robot: Two Franka Emika Panda arms with Franka Hand parallel grippers on fixed bases, each driven by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller

frame.suite: the simulator's world frame (metres, z up)
frame.base_text: midway between the two arm bases (panda_link0) at their height (world (0, 0.42, 0.71)), facing where both arms face: +X forward (world -y), +Y left (world +x), +Z up. Both arms face +X; the arm the scene calls left stands at Y = -0.28 (on this frame's right side), the arm it calls right at Y = +0.28

left.note: the arm the scene calls left (layout columns left_*); end-effector pose = its panda_hand frame; joint_positions = its two finger position targets (m each, 0 closed, 0.04 open)

ee.point: the left panda_hand frame (the hand's flange); the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m further along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis
ee.mode_text: a streamed pose target that the operational-space controller tracks; move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

right.note: the arm the scene calls right (layout columns right_*); end-effector pose = its panda_hand frame; joint_positions = its two finger position targets (m each, 0 closed, 0.04 open)

ee.point: the right panda_hand frame (the hand's flange); the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m further along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis
ee.mode_text: a streamed pose target that the operational-space controller tracks; move_robot interpolates the path at about 0.15 m/s

notes: Each arm takes end-effector poses only, tracked by EmbodiedSWE's operational-space (torque) controller; the arm joints take no direct command. Both arms can move in one move_robot call (one goal per arm). The end-effector pose of an arm is its panda_hand frame, not the fingertips: the point midway between the fingertips is 0.1034 m along the hand's own +Z (approach) axis from it. An arm's two joint_positions are its finger position targets (finger_1, finger_2, metres each: 0 = closed, 0.04 = open): send both together, e.g. [0.04, 0.04] to open and [0.0, 0.0] to close; a closed target on an object squeezes it. gripper_opening_m is the measured distance between that hand's finger pads (about 0.08 fully open). The measured joint angles are in observe's proprio_now (its layout: describe_robot's spec_file, proprio_layout). One episode, no reset; it ends by itself once the task is complete.
